prompt:
REFERENCES
@image1 — Michelle, 63: face, hair and build only.
@image2 — the bedroom: copy it — the white vanity and oval mirror right of centre, the lilac stool, the curtained window on the right, the cream bed on the left.
@audio1 — Michelle's voice.

SHOT: A quiet animated drama: one morning at the vanity Michelle goes through every bottle she owns, gives up, and sweeps them away; one take of 4 shots, 9:16, 15 s.

TIMELINE
[0–4s] Shot 1 · medium, overhead track: Frame 1: Michelle on the stool at the vanity in the morning, her hand over a crowd of a dozen unlabelled bottles and jars — her hand moves across the bottles, touching three; the camera tracks overhead with it. Michelle says: "Every cream. Every serum. Every foundation on the shelf."
[4–9s] Shot 2 · medium close-up, slow push-in: she lowers the jar to the vanity as she speaks; the camera pushes in. A beat of stillness first. Michelle says: "The Estée Lauder, the L'Oréal. And I look older in all of them."
[9–12s] Shot 3 · full shot, the camera pulls back: one sweep of the arm, the drawer slides shut; the camera pulls back and up.
[12–15s] Shot 4 · wide, crane up: she sits back on the stool and lowers her head; the crane rises. Last frame: Michelle sitting back on the stool, the vanity bare, the drawer shut, the room cool and quiet.

LOOK: A theatrical 3D animated feature, stylised adults with large expressive eyes, soft skin, sculpted hair, fabric with weight; natural, ungraded colour; light from cool morning daylight through the sheer curtains, a shadow side on every face. Michelle: the dusty-mauve knit cardigan over a grey T-shirt and charcoal pull-on trousers.

SOUND: Dialogue in natural American English — Michelle's voice from @audio1; only the person written as speaking speaks, and on every other shot nobody speaks. No music. The actions' own sounds: glass bottles clinking, the drawer sliding shut, her sigh; a still bedroom under it.

KEEP: same faces, hair and clothes in every frame; just Michelle in the scene; text, logos and captions nowhere; five fingers on each hand; real weight and timing; eyes off the lens
